RESEARCH.md.fragment: **改革也改变判断的证据 / Reform changes its own evidence，2026-10-08。** [本轮相连检验](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/REFORM-EVIDENCE-INTEGRATION.md)在实际目的修订历史中接通新维护负担、报告排除、错误认可、有成本的直接取得及保留新目的的修复。**23项新 Lean 定理／43项声明审计**通过；93项继承定理／165项审计分列。/ The two post-reform histories have identical admitted judgment inputs but different real losses. A paid check and authorized repair restore maintenance without erasing earlier losses. Existing goal-continuation, model-revision and correction-infrastructure results retain credit. Acquired access and remedy selection without a supplied route remain the frontier; no empirical validation or algorithmic superiority is claimed.
